During the [[Mission to Voss (Emperor's ritual crisis)|mission]] to stop the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] from unleashing a plague of madness across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] city of [[Gorma-Koss]] in order to infiltrate the subterranean [[King's Hall]] and retrieve maps of the [[Nightmare Lands]].
